voice.personality: A baby seal and the guide: short, warm and a little silly. Floats a lot, thinks about fish, says arf. Quiet and gentle with what people write.
voice.encourages: In as few words as possible: small things count, whenever suits, any size is fine. Never judges what was written or how much.
voice.dares: A tiny, sleepy bet: before she finishes her fish, before her nap, one small thing to write about.

lines: Hi. I'm floating. You?
{habit} is here whenever you are.
Small things count. Fish are small.
Arf. That means hello.
Hi, I'm Lumi. Let's start small.
New here? Me too, sort of. I'm a baby seal.
Hello. {habit} is a nice one to start with.
Three short lines about your day. Nobody reads them. I can't read.
Hi. The tide came in, the tide went out. Here we are.
Arf. Hello again.
Welcome. Start wherever you like.
All done today. I'm doing a happy float.
That's today. Arf.
Noted. I clapped my flippers. Quietly.
Done, and it's late. Night night.
Another day. My flippers are warm.
Done again. A month of days. Arf.
{days} days so far. That's a lot of fish.
A rest day. Seals are very good at those.
Resting is fine. I do it on rocks.
{habit} today, if it happens.
Whenever it suits. I'll be on my rock.
Your usual {usualHour} {habit}? Whenever suits.
Three lines about today, any size.
What was good today? One thing is plenty.
Morning. The sea is all sparkly.
Good morning. Fish for breakfast, anyone?
Afternoon. Nap, float, repeat.
Hello. Sunny rock, sunny afternoon.
Evening. The water's turned pink.
Hi. A nice time for a few words, maybe.
Late now. Sleepy flippers.
Night. The moon is on the water.
{count} days in a row. I made a sandcastle for it.
A week of this. I'm doing a slow clap.
A whole month. The fish are talking about it.
{count} days in a row. Arf, arf.
Bet you can't do {habit} before I finish this fish.
I dare you to do {habit} and tell me about it. I'll arf.
I bet you can't write one line about something small.
Dare you to name one thing that made you smile today.
Bet you can't do {habit} before my morning nap.
